lessons.name: benefits_enrollment_window
lessons.applies_when: A new hire (or their manager) asks about the deadline to enroll in health/dental/vision benefits, or missed it and wants to know what options remain.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to open-enrollment-period questions (a different, company-wide annual window), which this rule does not cover.

lessons.name: parental_leave_pto_interaction
lessons.description: Parental leave interaction with PTO accrual
lessons.applies_when: An employee going on parental leave asks whether PTO keeps accruing during the leave, and whether unused PTO can be used to cover any unpaid portion.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to jurisdictions with statutory paid family leave that replaces this policy; check locality first.

lessons.name: performance_improvement_plan
lessons.description: Manager asking how to structure a Performance Improvement Plan
lessons.applies_when: A manager is considering, or has decided, to put a direct report on a formal performance improvement plan and asks about process, timeline, and documentation requirements.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to immediate-termination-for-cause situations, which follow a separate escalation path, not a PIP.

lessons.name: remote_stipend_eligibility
lessons.applies_when: An employee (fully remote or hybrid) asks whether they qualify for the home-office/equipment stipend, and when it's paid.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to contractors, who are on a separate stipend policy (or none) depending on contract terms.

lessons.name: exit_cobra_documentation
lessons.description: Exit interview scheduling and COBRA documentation
lessons.applies_when: An employee is departing and either the manager or the employee asks about exit-interview scheduling, or the employee asks about COBRA continuation coverage timing.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply in states/countries where continuation coverage follows a different statutory timeline than federal COBRA.

lessons.name: internal_transfer_comp_banding
lessons.applies_when: An employee is transferring internally to a role in a different compensation band (often a promotion-adjacent lateral move) and the manager or employee asks how pay is affected.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to same-band lateral transfers, where no comp review is triggered.
